### Solomon Exalted
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomon-exalted
Passage: 1 Chronicles 29:25
Points:
- David's prayer models worship centered on God's universal sovereignty and infinite perfections rather than human strength.
- True humility acknowledges that all material possessions and wholehearted devotion originate entirely from the Lord.
- God demonstrated His abundant grace by elevating Solomon to greater royal majesty than any prior king in Israel.
- Daily prayers should move beyond selfish request lists to focus on praising God's sovereign character.
